set -euo pipefail

# Pooled IRT (N>=16) across 3 scales × 4 dosages × 2 seeds
# Benchmarks: ARC + GSM8K, S1-only exposure, MCMC warmup=2000 samples=2000

EVAL_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/eval_results"
CKPT_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints"
SIGNALS_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/exp002/signals"

MIN_N=16

SCALES=("0.5B" "1.5B" "3B")

SEEDS=("42" "123")
BENCHMARKS=("arc_challenge" "gsm8k")

DRY_RUN=""
FORCE_ORACLE=0
for arg in "$@"; do
    case "$arg" in
        --dry-run) DRY_RUN="--dry-run" ;;

    esac

echo "============================================"
echo "  Pooled IRT N>=${MIN_N} — Prerequisite Check"
echo "============================================"

MISSING_EVAL=()
MISSING_SFT=()

    for dose in "${DOSAGES[@]}"; do
        for seed in "${SEEDS[@]}"; do
            tag="${scale} d${dose} s${seed}"
            eval_path="${EVAL_DIR}/Qwen2.5-${scale}_d${dose}_s${seed}_aligned"

                printf "  ✗ %-22s SFT done, eval MISSING\n" "$tag"
                MISSING_EVAL+=("$tag")
            else
                printf "  ✗ %-22s SFT MISSING\n" "$tag"
                MISSING_SFT+=("$tag")

        done
    done

            echo "  - $m"

        echo ""
        echo "Need SFT + eval:"
        for m in "${MISSING_SFT[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $m"
        done
    fi
    exit 1

FIT_TIMEOUT = 7200  # 2 hours per fit


def fit_nuts(stan_data, seed=42, parallel_chains=None):
    model = cmdstanpy.CmdStanModel(stan_file=STAN_FILE)
    sample_kwargs = dict(
        data=stan_data,
        chains=4,
        iter_warmup=500,
        iter_sampling=1000,
        seed=seed,
        adapt_delta=0.95,
        max_treedepth=10,
        show_progress=False,
        timeout=FIT_TIMEOUT,
    )
    if parallel_chains is not None:
        sample_kwargs["parallel_chains"] = parallel_chains
    fit = model.sample(**sample_kwargs)
    return fit


def evaluate(fit, true_params):

    gamma_draws = fit.stan_variable("gamma")
    gamma_mean = float(np.mean(gamma_draws))
    gamma_sd = float(np.std(gamma_draws))
